spec.expr:
last_over_time(
  {service_name="loki.source.kubernetes.pods"}
  | json run_id, elapsed_seconds
  | run_id="$run_id"
  | detected_level="debug"
  | unwrap elapsed_seconds
  | __error__=""
  [$__range]
)

max_over_time(
  {job="loki.source.kubernetes.pods"}
  | json
  | event="train_step"
  | run_id="$run_id"
  | unwrap step
  | __error__=""
  [$__range]
) by (run_id)
and on (run_id)
topk(
  1,
  max_over_time(
    {job="loki.source.kubernetes.pods"}
    | json
    | event="training_started"
    | label_format started_at=`{{ __timestamp__ | unixEpoch }}`
    | unwrap started_at
    | __error__=""
    [$__range]
  ) by (run_id)
)
